fixed.fix: Added a 0.25.5 compatibility shim that re-exports the current 1.0.10 Mozilla root store using the 0.25 field names. It removes emSign ECC Root CA - G3.
fixed.verification: The shim regression test passes, strict clippy passes, and x3-chain-node compiles through libp2p-websocket against the patched crate.

remaining.reason: The patched release is crypto-bigint 0.7.6. Frontier and the ethers 2.x stack still require the 0.13 elliptic-curve/k256 line, so there is no semver-compatible lockfile fix.

launch_rule: Any remaining reachable vulnerability is a launch blocker until it is upgraded, removed from the production graph, or covered by a reviewed advisory-scope record with an executable precondition.
